name: ARchemy
tagline: An AR crafting game: combine elemental blocks with your fingertips to spawn new 3D objects around you.

awards: Snap: Spectacles AR Hackathon: Game On!

problem: Crafting games like Little Alchemy stay on a flat screen.
solution: On smart glasses, players pick up and merge elements, and a 3D generation service creates the resulting object in the room.
demo_moment: Team-described: combine fire and water and watch a new object appear in your hands.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Snap: Spectacles AR Hackathon: Game On!” among 261 submissions.
Moves a known browser game into the physical world.

lessons: Port a game everyone knows into the sponsor's medium.
